# Vendored: @joebobmiles/y-react

`@joebobmiles/y-react` (and the whole `@joebobmiles` npm scope) was unpublished
from the npm registry, so it can no longer be installed as a normal
dependency. The GitHub source (https://github.com/joebobmiles/y-react) is
still intact and unarchived, so this is that source at tag `v1.2.0` (commit
`7f0a65b43595302954c455f789b162c7ff671278`), copied in verbatim - only the
`@/`-aliased imports were rewritten to relative paths (this project has no
path-alias config) and the `.spec.ts(x)` test files were dropped.
